name: Md Saifi Hassan
title: Software Engineer III
description: Software Engineer III with 4 years of experience building scalable web applications and In-Flight Entertainment platforms

about.description1: As a Software Engineer III at Thales with 4 years in the industry, I've built production-ready In-Flight Entertainment platforms for airlines including Spirit, Delta, Emirates, and Air India. I work across the full stack with React, TypeScript, Spring Boot, and Golang — from Spring Boot microservices and content ingestion pipelines to performant frontends optimized for low-powered seatback hardware serving millions of passengers.
about.description2: I started my career after completing my B.Tech in Computer Science, where I won Smart India Hackathon twice. Since then, I've focused on full-stack development, CI/CD automation with Jenkins and Docker, and comprehensive testing with Jest and Cypress. I enjoy tackling complex technical challenges and building software that performs reliably at scale.
